description: Working days for a country. mode=between counts the working days after `from` up to and including `to` (up to 5 years) and lists the public holidays skipped; mode=add gives the date that is N working days after `date` (up to 3,650). Weekends are Saturday and Sunday, Friday and Saturday in Israel, and Friday only in Iran and Afghanistan. Nationwide public holidays from Nager.Date; a country with no holiday data is a 404, not charged. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, US, IL

days.description: Working days to add, negative to subtract, up to 3,650 in size (mode add)

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (mode between; not counted)

name: business_days
title: Business Days
